3bee: Italian naturetech company that develops technology for monitoring and regenerating biodiversity. In 2025 it launched XNatura, an internal division combining AI, IoT sensors and satellite data.
XNatura says 3Bee's Biodiversity Credits project was funded by the EIC Accelerator.
3Bee's “Biodiversity Credits” project, funded by the EIC Accelerator
Started in Milan in 2017 making IoT sensors for beekeepers; XNatura arrived in 2022.
3Bee è nata a Milano nel 2017 costruendo sensori IoT per apicoltori; la piattaforma XNatura è arrivata nel 2022.
3d-coastal-mapping-programme: A programme launched in 2025 to map up to 40 percent of New Zealand's coastline, run by Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand and led by Stuart Caie, with Woolpert Asia-Pacific and NV5 Geospatial among its suppliers.
Launched in 2025, with an objective of mapping up to 40 percent of New Zealand's coastline.
The 3DCM Programme has made significant progress toward its objective of mapping up to 40 percent of New Zealand’s coastline.
Its suppliers include Woolpert Asia-Pacific and NV5 Geospatial.
We also acknowledge our suppliers Woolpert Asia-Pacific and NV5 Geospatial for their work in delivering this data

3lynx: Interreg Central Europe project that ran from July 2017 to June 2020 with a 2,318,784 euro allocation, aiming to coordinate lynx monitoring in three isolated populations using camera traps and winter snow tracking.
Ran from July 2017 to June 2020 under Interreg Central Europe, with ERDF and Czech Ministry of the Environment funding and a total allocation of 2,318,784 euros.
The project aimed to coordinate monitoring of lynx in three isolated populations spanning several states.
Cílem projektu 3Lynx je zkoordinovat monitorování výskytu rysů ve 3 izolovaných populacích, které zasahují několik států.
Lynx populations were to be followed in two cross-border regions with a network of camera traps and winter snow tracking.

3d-hyperspektral-ai-biologisk-mangfald: A project led by Linköping University and funded by Vinnova, running October 2023 to September 2026 and now closed, which aimed to develop a 3D hyperspectral imaging AI system.
The October 2023–September 2026 project aimed to develop a 3D hyperspectral imaging AI system.
